mapper.sql: select oo.id, oo.outbound_order_id, oo.outbound_batch_id, oo.outbound_status, oo.outbound_type,oo.outbound_object_name,oo.outbound_object_id,oo.outbound_user, CASE oo.outbound_type WHEN 1 THEN '销售出库' WHEN 2 THEN '调拨出库' ELSE '' END as outbound_type_name, oo.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, oo.related_order_no, oo.outbound_object_id, oo.outbound_user, oo.outbound_dept, oo.outbound_time, oo.audit_time, oo.audit_user, oo.operator, oo.created_at, oo.updated_at, oo.remark from outbound_order oo left join inv_warehouse w on oo.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update outbound_order set outbound_status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from outbound_order where outbound_status = 'pending'
and warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
select release_id, release_name, CONCAT(release_name, ' (', release_id, ')') as display_text from t_input_release_main where is_deleted = 0 order by operate_time desc

select d.id, d.release_detail_id, d.release_id, d.crop_type, d.variety as detail_variety, d.input_id, d.input_type, d.input_category, d.required, d.quantity, d.unit, d.unit_price, d.release_time, i.input_name, i.type as input_type_from_input, i.agricultural_input_type as agricultural_input_type_from_input, i.variety as input_variety from t_input_release_detail d left join agri_input i on d.input_id = i.input_id and i.del_flag = '0' where d.release_id = #{releaseId} and d.is_deleted = 0 order by d.release_time desc

select id, release_id, release_name, zone_id, target_id, target_address, target_contact, target_phone, release_year, release_date, release_by, audit_date, audit_by, release_org, release_type, operate_by, operate_time, is_deleted from t_input_release_main where release_id = #{releaseId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: update t_input_receive_union r inner join t_input_release_main m on r.release_id = m.release_id set r.receive_status = #{receiveStatus}, r.confirm_time = NOW() where m.id = #{releaseId} and m.is_deleted = '0' and r.is_deleted = '0'

update t_input_receive_woreda r inner join t_input_release_main m on r.release_id = m.release_id set r.receive_status = #{receiveStatus}, r.confirm_time = NOW() where m.id = #{releaseId} and m.is_deleted = '0' and r.is_deleted = '0'
